name: Return the Statuette
summary: Karl Boran in Menethil Harbor asks you to bring back the Menethil Statuette. The figurine was found inside the barrel pulled from the muck, and its recovery matters to the Blind Princess's captain.

sections.title: The Figurine
sections.body: You found the statuette packed in fine straw inside the barrel. It shows a young, long-haired Paladin raising a hammer. Karl Boran in Menethil Harbor is waiting for its return, and the Blind Princess's captain will be relieved to hear the cargo is safe.

faq.answer: The Menethil Statuette is a silvery figurine showing a young, long-haired Paladin with a raised hammer.
The statuette was packed in fine straw inside a barrel pulled from the muck.

faq.q: Who is waiting for the statuette?
faq.answer: Karl Boran in Menethil Harbor is waiting for the Menethil Statuette.

faq.q: Who will be relieved when it is returned?
faq.answer: The captain of the Blind Princess will be relieved that the precious cargo has been recovered.
It depicts a young, long-haired Paladin with a hammer raised.
